types.name: ai.v1.ApprovalDecision
types.doc: ApprovalDecision is the user's answer to an approval request.

values.name: APPROVE
values.doc: Approve: the action runs exactly as summarized.

values.name: REJECT
values.doc: Reject: the action does not run.

types.name: ai.v1.ApprovalParameter
types.doc:
ApprovalParameter is one key parameter of the action an approval approves,
 for example "Slice interval" and "5 s".

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Short label, in plain words.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The value, in plain words, with its unit or asset when it has one.

types.name: ai.v1.ApprovalRequested
types.doc:
ApprovalRequested reports that the run waits for the user to approve an
 action, such as placing an order. The run continues once DecideApproval
 answers it, or the approval expires. Nothing runs without an approval.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.doc: Public approval ID, the argument of DecideApproval.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: What approving does, written from the exact action, never by the model.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: When the approval expires if undecided.

fields.name: parameters
fields.doc:
The action's key parameters in display order, such as the market, side,
 quantity, prices, a TWAP's duration and slices or a ladder's range,
 written from the same exact action as the summary. Show them with the
 summary.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the action acts on: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: order_preview
fields.doc: The order the approval places.

fields.name: cancel_orders
fields.doc: The open orders the approval cancels.

fields.name: order_change
fields.doc: The change the approval makes to open limit orders.

fields.name: trigger_change
fields.doc: The change the approval makes to a trigger.

fields.name: place_orders
fields.doc: The limit orders the approval places together.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc: The swap the approval executes within the trading account.

fields.name: cancel_trigger
fields.doc: The trigger the approval cancels.

types.name: ai.v1.ApprovalResolved
types.doc: ApprovalResolved reports the final state of an approval request.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.doc: Public approval ID, as in its ApprovalRequested event.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: APPROVED, REJECTED or EXPIRED.

types.name: ai.v1.ApprovalStatus
types.doc: ApprovalStatus is the state of an approval request.

values.name: PENDING
values.doc: Waiting for a decision.

values.name: APPROVED
values.doc: Approved by the user.

values.name: REJECTED
values.doc: Rejected by the user.

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc: Expired before a decision; the action did not run.

types.name: ai.v1.AssistantKey
types.doc:
AssistantKey is the assistant's key for one of the caller's accounts. The
 assistant holds its private key; the API key it belongs to is listed and
 revoked with the caller's other API keys.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Subaccount the key acts on. Omitted for the main account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Opaque identifier of the API key.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc: Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: ACTIVE or DISABLED.

types.name: ai.v1.AssistantKeyAccount
types.doc: AssistantKeyAccount names one account to give the assistant a key for.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Subaccount. Omit for the main account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.AssistantKeyState
types.doc: AssistantKeyState is the state of an assistant key the assistant holds.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: The assistant uses the key for its account.

values.name: DISABLED
values.doc:
The key was disabled when the assistant last checked it. The assistant
 keeps it and uses it again once it is enabled.

types.name: ai.v1.AttachedExit
types.doc: AttachedExit is an attached take-profit or stop-loss.

fields.name: trigger_price
fields.doc:
The price that fires the exit, an exact decimal string in the quote
 asset.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The exit's limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.
 Omitted when the exit is a market order.

types.name: ai.v1.AttachedExits
types.doc:
AttachedExits are exits that protect what a market or limit order fills,
 armed as it fills. They close the order's position: they sell what a buy
 order bought, so a take-profit fires above and a stop-loss below the entry,
 and they buy back what a sell order sold, the other way round.

fields.name: take_profit
fields.doc: The take-profit. Omitted when there is none.

fields.name: stop_loss
fields.doc:
The stop-loss. Omitted when there is none. Never set together with
 trailing_stop.

fields.name: trailing_stop
fields.doc: The trailing stop. Omitted when there is none.

fields.name: oco
fields.doc: True when cancelling one exit ends the other.

types.name: ai.v1.AttachedTrailingStop
types.doc: AttachedTrailingStop is an attached trailing stop.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: A price distance, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: distance_bps
fields.doc: A distance in basis points of the price: 50 is 0.5%.

fields.name: activation_price
fields.doc:
Tracking starts once the price reaches it, an exact decimal string in
 the quote asset. Omitted when tracking starts at once.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The most the buy-back pays, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.
 Set only when the order sells.

types.name: ai.v1.BalanceHistoryChart
types.doc:
BalanceHistoryChart shows how the caller's balance of each asset changed
 over a window ending at the time of the run.

fields.name: history
fields.doc:
The window and its series, as GetBalanceHistory returns them for the
 caller's trading account. A series whose every point is zero is left out,
 so an account that held nothing in the window has no series.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the history was read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.BalancesTable
types.doc: BalancesTable shows the caller's balances.

fields.name: balances
fields.doc: Balances, one per asset, highest available trading amount first.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the balances were read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.CancelOrdersPreview
types.doc:
CancelOrdersPreview is the exact set of open orders an approval cancels:
 orders named one by one, or every open order a cancel-all matches. It
 cancels orders only; triggers stay active.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc:
Every order it cancels: a cancel-all's oldest first, otherwise in the
 order the user named them. Approving cancels exactly these; an order that
 matches a cancel-all after the approval is not cancelled under it.

fields.name: cancel_all
fields.doc: True for a cancel-all: every open order on symbols and side.

fields.name: symbols
fields.doc:
A cancel-all's markets, for example "BTC-USDT". Empty for every market,
 and for orders named one by one.

fields.name: side
fields.doc:
A cancel-all's side, BUY or SELL. Unspecified for both sides, and for
 orders named one by one.

fields.name: live_triggers_kept
fields.doc:
A cancel-all's live triggers on its markets that stay active, as
 counted when it was requested. A lower bound when
 live_triggers_kept_lower_bound is true.

fields.name: live_triggers_kept_lower_bound
fields.doc:
True when live_triggers_kept counts only the live triggers read, and
 more may stay active.

types.name: ai.v1.CancelRunRequest
types.doc: CancelRunRequest selects the run to cancel.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc: Run to cancel.

types.name: ai.v1.CancelRunResponse
types.doc: CancelRunResponse confirms that the cancellation was recorded.

types.name: ai.v1.CancelTriggerPreview
types.doc:
CancelTriggerPreview is the exact trigger an approval cancels, as it was
 when the cancellation was requested.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: type
fields.doc: STOP_LOSS, TAKE_PROFIT, TRAILING_STOP, TWAP or LADDER.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Its total quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset.

fields.name: trigger_price
fields.doc:
A stop-loss's or take-profit's trigger price, or a trailing stop's
 current trigger price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.
 Omitted for a TWAP or ladder, and when it has none yet.

fields.name: filled_quantity
fields.doc:
A TWAP's or ladder's quantity filled so far, an exact decimal string in
 the base asset. Omitted for other types.

fields.name: slices_done
fields.doc: A TWAP's slices done so far. Omitted for other types.

fields.name: slice_count
fields.doc: A TWAP's number of slices. Omitted for other types.

fields.name: levels_filled
fields.doc: A ladder's levels with at least one fill. Omitted for other types.

fields.name: level_count
fields.doc: A ladder's number of levels. Omitted for other types.

fields.name: cancels_open_orders
fields.doc:
True when cancelling it also cancels its open orders: a TWAP's or a
 ladder's.

types.name: ai.v1.CompleteAssistantKeysRequest
types.doc: CompleteAssistantKeysRequest selects the setup whose keys were registered.

fields.name: setup_id
fields.doc: Setup from PrepareAssistantKeysResponse.

types.name: ai.v1.CompleteAssistantKeysResponse
types.doc: CompleteAssistantKeysResponse returns the keys the assistant now uses.

fields.name: keys
fields.doc: The caller's assistant keys the assistant holds, oldest first.

types.name: ai.v1.Conversation
types.doc: Conversation is one conversation of the caller with the assistant.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc: Public conversation ID.

fields.name: title
fields.doc:
Short title, derived from the conversation's first messages. Empty until
 one is available.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the conversation was started.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the latest message of the conversation was recorded.

types.name: ai.v1.DecideApprovalRequest
types.doc: DecideApprovalRequest answers one approval request.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.doc: Approval to decide, from an ApprovalRequested event.

fields.name: decision
fields.doc: The decision.

types.name: ai.v1.DecideApprovalResponse
types.doc: DecideApprovalResponse returns the recorded state of the approval.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: APPROVED or REJECTED.

types.name: ai.v1.DeleteMemoryRequest
types.doc: DeleteMemoryRequest selects the memory to forget.

fields.name: memory_id
fields.doc: Memory to delete.

types.name: ai.v1.DeleteMemoryResponse
types.doc: DeleteMemoryResponse confirms the deletion.

types.name: ai.v1.DepositAddressCard
types.doc:
DepositAddressCard shows one of the caller's deposit addresses, to copy. An
 address takes deposits only on its own chain: show that chain's name next to
 the address, and warn that sending another asset, or using another chain,
 can lose the funds.

fields.name: deposit_address
fields.doc:
The address and the chain it is assigned on. Resolve the chain's name, and
 the assets it carries, with GetDepositWithdrawConfig.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Public unified asset ID (AssetConfig.ledger_id) the caller asked to
 deposit to this address. Omitted when the card shows the address without
 one asset, for example in a list of the caller's addresses.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the address belongs to: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.Destination
types.doc:
Destination is one place in the client the assistant may offer the user to
 go to: a page, or a dialog such as deposit or transfer. The client declares
 the destinations it has with each message; the assistant suggests them by
 id, and the client maps each id to its own page or dialog.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
The client's id of the destination, for example "page-subaccounts":
 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: title
fields.doc:
Its name as the client shows it, for example "Subaccounts", 1 to 80
 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.doc:
What the user does there, in a few words or keywords, at most 200
 characters, for example "sub accounts, account management". The assistant
 reads it to choose a destination.

types.name: ai.v1.DestinationsSuggested
types.doc:
DestinationsSuggested reports the places in the client the assistant
 offers the user to go to, for example to create a subaccount or change a
 setting: show each as a button. The ids are those the run's SendMessage
 declared in destinations; the client maps each to its own page or dialog.
 The event follows the ToolFinished event, with ok true, of the
 suggest_destinations call that chose them.

fields.name: tool_call_id
fields.doc:
Identifier of the tool call, as in its ToolStarted and ToolFinished
 events.

fields.name: destination_ids
fields.doc:
1 to 3 destination ids, most relevant first, each declared in the run's
 SendMessage destinations. A client that no longer knows an id skips it.

types.name: ai.v1.DiscardPartial
types.doc:
DiscardPartial withdraws answer text that is about to be written again. The
 assistant was interrupted while writing and regenerates its answer from an
 earlier point; the regenerated text follows in later TextDelta events.

fields.name: from_seq
fields.doc:
Drop the text of every TextDelta of this run whose seq is equal to or
 greater than this value, and received before this event. Tool, view and
 other events stay.

types.name: ai.v1.EquityHistoryChart
types.doc:
EquityHistoryChart shows the value of the caller's holdings over a window
 ending at the time of the run.

fields.name: history
fields.doc:
The window and its series, as GetEquityHistorySeries returns them for the
 caller's trading account, grouped by account bucket or by asset.
 btc_prices_q is not set. The account's total equity at a point is the sum
 of every series at that point.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the history was read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies an Assistant API error.

values.name: CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No conversation of the caller has this ID.

values.name: RUN_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No run of the caller has this ID.

values.name: APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No approval of the caller has this ID.

values.name: MEMORY_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No memory of the caller has this ID.

values.name: RUN_ACTIVE
values.doc:
The conversation already has an active run. Wait for it to end, or cancel
 it, before sending another message.

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The idempotency key was already used with a different request. The
 original run stands.

values.name: APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED
values.doc:
The approval was already decided the other way. The first decision
 stands.

values.name: APPROVAL_EXPIRED
values.doc: The approval expired before it was decided. Nothing was executed.

values.name: USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller sent too many messages or used up their assistant allowance;
 retry later.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.

values.name: KEY_SETUP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No pending key setup of the caller has this ID: it was never prepared,
 it expired without being registered, or a later setup replaced it.
 Prepare the keys again.

values.name: KEY_SETUP_NOT_REGISTERED
values.doc:
The setup's public keys are not registered as the caller's assistant
 keys: they were not submitted yet, or their registration was refused.
 Nothing changed.

types.name: ai.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Assistant API errors as an error detail of type
 ai.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

types.name: ai.v1.FailureCategory
types.doc: FailureCategory classifies why a run failed.

values.name: CANCELLED
values.doc: The run was cancelled with CancelRun.

values.name: BUDGET_EXCEEDED
values.doc: The run reached its step or usage budget before it could finish.

values.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: The run needed an action the caller is not permitted to take.

values.name: MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The language model was unavailable and the run could not continue; send
 the message again later.

values.name: UNEXPECTED_ERROR
values.doc: The run could not continue because of an unexpected error.

types.name: ai.v1.GetTelegramApprovalLimitsRequest
types.doc:
GetTelegramApprovalLimitsRequest reads the caller's Telegram approval
 limits.

types.name: ai.v1.GetTelegramApprovalLimitsResponse
types.doc:
GetTelegramApprovalLimitsResponse returns the caller's Telegram approval
 limits and what counts against the daily one.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: The limits; both unset when the caller set none.

fields.name: approved_last_24h_usd
fields.doc:
Notional value approved from Telegram in the last 24 hours while a limit
 was set, in US dollars: a decimal string with 2 decimal places.

types.name: ai.v1.LadderLevel
types.doc: LadderLevel is one limit order of a ladder.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: Its price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Its quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset.

types.name: ai.v1.LadderPreview
types.doc:
LadderPreview is a ladder: good-till-canceled limit orders spread evenly
 across a price range, all placed at once.

fields.name: low_price
fields.doc: The lowest level's price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: high_price
fields.doc: The highest level's price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: levels
fields.doc:
Every level, lowest price first: 2 to 100. The quantity is split
 equally, rounded down to the step size; the highest level gets the rest.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: True when every level is refused instead of trading at once.

fields.name: time_in_force
fields.doc: Every level's time in force: GTC.

fields.name: all_levels_at_once
fields.doc: True when every level is placed at once, when the ladder is created.

types.name: ai.v1.LimitOrderPreview
types.doc: LimitOrderPreview is a limit order: it trades at its price or better.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: time_in_force
fields.doc: GTC, GTD, IOC or FOK.

fields.name: expire_at
fields.doc: When a GTD order expires. Omitted for other times in force.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: True when the order is refused instead of trading at once.

fields.name: attached
fields.doc: Exits attached to the order. Omitted when it has none.

types.name: ai.v1.ListAssistantKeysRequest
types.doc: ListAssistantKeysRequest lists the assistant keys the assistant holds.

types.name: ai.v1.ListAssistantKeysResponse
types.doc: ListAssistantKeysResponse returns the assistant keys the assistant holds.

fields.name: keys
fields.doc:
The caller's assistant keys the assistant holds, oldest first, at most
 one per account.

types.name: ai.v1.ListConversationsRequest
types.doc:
ListConversationsRequest pages through the caller's conversations, most
 recently updated first.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum conversations to return. 0 means the default of 20; maximum 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound to
 the caller, updated_at and conversation_id.

types.name: ai.v1.ListConversationsResponse
types.doc: ListConversationsResponse returns conversations.

fields.name: conversations
fields.doc:
Conversations ordered by updated_at descending, then conversation_id
 descending. A conversation updated while paging moves to the front, so a
 chain of pages started earlier does not return it again.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: ai.v1.ListMemoriesRequest
types.doc: ListMemoriesRequest pages through the caller's memories, newest first.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum memories to return. 0 means the default of 50; maximum 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound to
 the caller, created_at and memory_id.

types.name: ai.v1.ListMemoriesResponse
types.doc: ListMemoriesResponse returns memories.

fields.name: memories
fields.doc: Memories ordered by created_at descending, then memory_id descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: ai.v1.ListMessagesRequest
types.doc: ListMessagesRequest pages through one conversation's messages, newest first.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc: Conversation to read.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum messages to return. 0 means the default of 50; maximum 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound to
 the caller, the conversation, created_at and message_id.

types.name: ai.v1.ListMessagesResponse
types.doc: ListMessagesResponse returns messages.

fields.name: messages
fields.doc: Messages ordered by created_at descending, then message_id descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: ai.v1.MarkdownTable
types.doc: MarkdownTable is a generic table, for example a comparison of markets.

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Column headings, each inline Markdown.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc:
Rows in display order. A row has at most as many cells as there are
 columns; missing cells are empty.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: True when the source had more rows than the table shows.

types.name: ai.v1.MarkdownTableRow
types.doc: MarkdownTableRow is one row of a MarkdownTable.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Cells in column order, each inline Markdown.

types.name: ai.v1.MarketOrderPreview
types.doc: MarketOrderPreview is a market order: it fills at once against the book.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
The most the price may move against the order, in basis points: 50 is
 0.5%. Omitted when the market's default cap applies.

fields.name: attached
fields.doc: Exits attached to the order. Omitted when it has none.

types.name: ai.v1.MemoriesRecalled
types.doc:
MemoriesRecalled reports the memories one memory search of the run
 returned. The assistant searches the user's memories for their message
 before it answers, and may search again while answering, each time as a
 recall_memories tool call. A search returns only the memories relevant to
 what it searched for, so a message unrelated to every saved memory recalls
 none. Profile memories are never searched: the assistant applies them to
 every answer, and they are not reported here. The event follows that call's
 ToolFinished event with ok true; a failed search has a ToolFinished event
 with ok false and no MemoriesRecalled event.

fields.name: tool_call_id
fields.doc:
Identifier of the search's tool call, as in its ToolStarted and
 ToolFinished events.

fields.name: memories
fields.doc:
The relevant memories found, at most 8, most relevant first; never a
 profile memory. Empty when none is relevant.

types.name: ai.v1.Memory
types.doc:
Memory is one fact the assistant remembers about the caller across
 conversations, such as a stated preference. A corrected fact replaces the
 earlier one, which is no longer listed.

fields.name: memory_id
fields.doc: Public memory ID.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The remembered fact, in plain text.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the fact was remembered.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc:
The conversation the fact was learned in. Omitted when that conversation
 is unknown.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What kind of fact the memory holds.

types.name: ai.v1.MemoryKind
types.doc: MemoryKind is what kind of fact a memory holds.

values.name: FACT
values.doc: A lasting fact or preference the user stated about themselves.

values.name: PLANNING_FIGURE
values.doc:
A figure the user stated for their own planning, such as the account size
 they plan risk against. It is never a balance.

values.name: PROFILE
values.doc:
A standing preference for how the assistant addresses and talks to the
 user, such as the name to use, the language, the tone and length of
 answers, or how risks are explained. The assistant applies every profile
 memory to every answer, so it is never searched and never appears in a
 MemoriesRecalled event. A user holds at most 10 profile memories.

types.name: ai.v1.Message
types.doc: Message is one message of a conversation.

fields.name: message_id
fields.doc: Public message ID.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Author of the message.

fields.name: text
fields.doc:
Message text in Markdown. For an assistant message, the final text of its
 run; tool activity and views are not part of it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the message was recorded.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc:
The run the message started (user) or the run that wrote it (assistant).
 Replay that run with WatchRun from after_seq 0 to show its tool activity
 and views.

types.name: ai.v1.MessageRole
types.doc: MessageRole is the author of a conversation message.

values.name: USER
values.doc: The user.

values.name: ASSISTANT
values.doc: The assistant.

types.name: ai.v1.OrderChange
types.doc:
OrderChange is one open limit order a modification changes, before and
 after.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The limit price now, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: new_price
fields.doc:
The new limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset. Omitted
 when the price does not change.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc:
The total quantity now, filled part included, an exact decimal string in
 the base asset.

fields.name: new_quantity
fields.doc:
The new total quantity, filled part included, an exact decimal string in
 the base asset. Omitted when the quantity does not change.

fields.name: filled_quantity
fields.doc: Quantity filled so far, an exact decimal string in the base asset.

fields.name: replaced
fields.doc:
True when the change replaces the order with a new order under a new
 order ID, at the back of the queue: a new price or a larger quantity.
 False when it amends the order in place, keeping its queue position.

types.name: ai.v1.OrderChangePreview
types.doc:
OrderChangePreview is the exact change an approval makes to open limit
 orders of one market: their price or total quantity, before and after.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: base_asset
fields.doc: Base asset, for example "BTC".

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset, for example "USDT".

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: Every order it changes, in the order the user named them.

types.name: ai.v1.OrderPreview
types.doc:
OrderPreview is the exact order an approval places, as typed values to
 draw it: a TWAP's slices on a timeline, a ladder's levels on a price axis,
 a stop's trigger price against the current price. It is computed from the
 exact order by the assistant's order checks, never written by the model,
 and states the same order as the approval's summary and parameters.
 Prices are exact decimal strings in the quote asset, quantities in the
 base asset.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "SOL-USDT".

fields.name: base_asset
fields.doc: Base asset, for example "SOL".

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset, for example "USDT".

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc:
Total quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset. Omitted only
 for a buy sized by quote_amount.

fields.name: quote_amount
fields.doc:
A buy market order, or buy immediate-or-cancel limit order, sized by
 spend: the most quote asset it spends, an exact decimal string. Omitted
 when quantity is set.

fields.name: estimated_value
fields.doc:
Estimated order value in the quote asset, a decimal string rounded to at
 most 2 decimals. Valued at: quote_amount when set; a market order or TWAP
 of market slices at reference_price; a limit order, ladder level or limit
 slice at its price; a stop at its limit price, else its trigger price; a
 trailing stop at its limit price, else its activation price, else the last
 price. Omitted when it cannot be estimated.

fields.name: reserved_amount
fields.doc:
What the exchange reserves on the trading account when it creates a
 stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stop or ladder: an exact decimal string,
 in the base asset for a sell, in the quote asset (fee reserve included)
 for a buy. Omitted for market and limit orders, which reserve as they
 are placed, and for a TWAP, whose slices each use what is available when
 they are due.

fields.name: reference_price
fields.doc:
The current market price to draw the order against: for a stop-loss,
 take-profit or trailing stop the price it watches (last or index), for
 the others the best ask for a buy or the best bid for a sell. Omitted
 when the market has no such price.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: A market order.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: A limit order.

fields.name: stop_loss
fields.doc: A stop-loss.

fields.name: take_profit
fields.doc: A take-profit.

fields.name: trailing_stop
fields.doc: A trailing stop.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: A TWAP.

fields.name: ladder
fields.doc: A ladder.

fields.name: relative_prices
fields.doc:
The prices the user gave relative to another price, as resolved, in the
 order they appear in the order. Empty when every price was given as an
 absolute price.

types.name: ai.v1.OrderPriceField
types.doc: OrderPriceField names one price of an order.

values.name: LIMIT_PRICE
values.doc:
The limit price: of a limit order, of a stop-loss or take-profit's limit
 order, of a TWAP's limit slices; the most a buying trailing stop pays.

values.name: TRIGGER_PRICE
values.doc: A stop-loss or take-profit's trigger price.

values.name: ACTIVATION_PRICE
values.doc: A trailing stop's activation price.

values.name: LADDER_LOW_PRICE
values.doc: A ladder's lowest level price.

values.name: LADDER_HIGH_PRICE
values.doc: A ladder's highest level price.

values.name: TAKE_PROFIT_TRIGGER_PRICE
values.doc: An attached take-profit's trigger price.

values.name: TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT_PRICE
values.doc: An attached take-profit's limit exit price.

values.name: STOP_LOSS_TRIGGER_PRICE
values.doc: An attached stop-loss's trigger price.

values.name: STOP_LOSS_LIMIT_PRICE
values.doc: An attached stop-loss's limit exit price.

values.name: TRAILING_STOP_ACTIVATION_PRICE
values.doc: An attached trailing stop's activation price.

values.name: TRAILING_STOP_LIMIT_PRICE
values.doc: The most an attached trailing stop's buy-back pays.

types.name: ai.v1.OrderToCancel
types.doc:
OrderToCancel is one open order a cancellation cancels, as it was when the
 cancellation was requested.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: price
fields.doc:
The limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset. Omitted for
 a market order.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Total quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset.

fields.name: filled_quantity
fields.doc: Quantity filled so far, an exact decimal string in the base asset.

types.name: ai.v1.OrdersTable
types.doc: OrdersTable shows the caller's orders.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: Orders in the order the assistant fetched them, usually newest first.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: True when more orders matched than the table shows.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the orders were read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.PlaceOrdersPreview
types.doc:
PlaceOrdersPreview is the exact set of limit orders an approval places
 together. The exchange may refuse some of them and accept the others.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc:
Every order, in the order the user gave them, each as typed values with
 its own estimated value and reference price.

fields.name: total_values
fields.doc:
The estimated value of the whole set, one per quote asset, in the order
 the assets first appear in orders: the exact sum of its orders' values in
 that asset, then rounded.

types.name: ai.v1.PrepareAssistantKeysRequest
types.doc:
PrepareAssistantKeysRequest names the accounts to give the assistant keys
 for.

fields.name: accounts
fields.doc: 1 to 64 accounts, each at most once.

types.name: ai.v1.PrepareAssistantKeysResponse
types.doc: PrepareAssistantKeysResponse returns the public keys to register.

fields.name: setup_id
fields.doc: The setup, the argument of CompleteAssistantKeys.

fields.name: keys
fields.doc: One key per requested account, in request order.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
The keys' registration deadline: register them with SetAssistantKeys
 before this time. After it, they cannot be registered.

types.name: ai.v1.PreparedAssistantKey
types.doc: PreparedAssistantKey is a key pair the assistant generated for one account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Subaccount the key is for. Omitted for the main account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes. Register it as the account's assistant key
 with SetAssistantKeys.

fields.name: registration_proof
fields.doc:
The key's registration proof (64 bytes). Pass it unchanged as the key's
 registration_proof in SetAssistantKeys.

fields.name: registration_deadline
fields.doc:
The key's registration deadline. Pass it unchanged as the key's
 registration_deadline in SetAssistantKeys; the key cannot be registered
 after it.

types.name: ai.v1.PriceChart
types.doc: PriceChart shows candles of one spot market.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier; resolve its symbol with GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Timeframe of every candle.

fields.name: candles
fields.doc: Candles oldest first.

types.name: ai.v1.PriceOffsetDirection
types.doc: PriceOffsetDirection is which side of its reference a relative price is.

values.name: ABOVE
values.doc: Above the reference.

values.name: BELOW
values.doc: Below the reference.

types.name: ai.v1.PriceRounding
types.doc:
PriceRounding is which way a resolved price was rounded onto the market's
 tick size.

values.name: DOWN
values.doc: Down to the tick below: a price a buy trades at.

values.name: UP
values.doc: Up to the tick above: a price a sell trades at.

types.name: ai.v1.QuoteValue
types.doc: QuoteValue is a value in one quote asset.

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset, for example "USDT".

fields.name: value
fields.doc:
The value, a decimal string in quote_asset rounded to at most 2
 decimals.

types.name: ai.v1.RecalledMemory
types.doc: RecalledMemory is one memory the assistant recalled during a run.

fields.name: memory_id
fields.doc: Public memory ID, as ListMemories returns it and DeleteMemory accepts it.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The remembered fact, in plain text.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What kind of fact the memory holds.

types.name: ai.v1.ReferencePrice
types.doc:
ReferencePrice is one current market price the order preview read, to
 draw the order against.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Which market price it is.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.doc:
When the price was set: for LAST_PRICE the time of the market's last
 trade, for the others when the assistant read it.

types.name: ai.v1.ReferencePriceSource
types.doc: ReferencePriceSource names the market price a ReferencePrice is.

values.name: BEST_BID
values.doc: The best bid: the highest price a resting buy order offers.

values.name: BEST_ASK
values.doc: The best ask: the lowest price a resting sell order offers.

values.name: LAST_PRICE
values.doc: The price of the market's last trade.

values.name: INDEX_PRICE
values.doc: The market's index price, aggregated from external exchanges.

types.name: ai.v1.RelativePrice
types.doc:
RelativePrice is a price of the order that the user gave relative to
 another price, for example "10% below the current price", and that the
 assistant resolved to the absolute price the order carries. The order is
 placed at that absolute price, as approved, even when the reference moves
 afterwards.

fields.name: field
fields.doc: Which price of the order it is.

fields.name: price
fields.doc:
The resolved price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset, as the
 order carries it: the reference moved by offset_bps, then rounded onto
 the market's tick size in the direction never worse for the order that
 trades at it: down for a buy, up for a sell. An attached exit trades
 the other way from its order.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Whether the price is above or below the reference.

fields.name: offset_bps
fields.doc:
The offset from the reference in basis points: 1000 is 10%. From 0 to
 10000 above the reference, from 0 to 9999 below it. Zero is the
 reference itself, rounded onto the tick size as price says. A positive
 offset always resolves strictly above or below the reference, as
 direction says: one smaller than one tick size step is refused, never
 resolved to the reference or past it.

fields.name: market
fields.doc:
A market price the assistant read: for a stop-loss, take-profit or
 trailing stop the price it watches (last or index), for the others the
 best ask for a buy or the best bid for a sell; for an attached exit of
 a market order, that order's best ask or best bid. A reference set more
 than the approval's 10-minute lifetime before the approval was
 requested (a last price by its last trade) is refused.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The order's own limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote
 asset: the reference of an attached exit of a limit order.

fields.name: rounding
fields.doc:
Which way the moved reference was rounded onto tick_size: DOWN for a
 price a buy trades at, UP for a sell.

fields.name: tick_size
fields.doc:
The market's tick size the price was rounded onto, an exact decimal
 string in the quote asset.

types.name: ai.v1.RunCompleted
types.doc: RunCompleted is the last event of a run that finished its answer.

fields.name: usage
fields.doc: Language-model usage of the run.

types.name: ai.v1.RunEvent
types.doc:
RunEvent is one recorded event of a run. Events are recorded before they are
 sent, so a stream resumed from the last seq a client received misses and
 repeats nothing.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc:
Position of the event in its run: 1 for the first event, then increasing
 by exactly one.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the event was recorded.

fields.name: text_delta
fields.doc: Answer text to append.

fields.name: discard_partial
fields.doc: Answer text to withdraw before it is written again.

fields.name: tool_started
fields.doc: A tool call started.

fields.name: tool_finished
fields.doc: A tool call finished.

fields.name: skill_loaded
fields.doc: A skill was loaded.

fields.name: subagent_started
fields.doc: A subagent started a delegated task.

fields.name: subagent_finished
fields.doc: A subagent finished its task.

fields.name: approval_requested
fields.doc: The run waits for an approval.

fields.name: approval_resolved
fields.doc: An approval was decided or expired.

fields.name: view
fields.doc: Structured content to render.

fields.name: run_completed
fields.doc: The run finished its answer. Last event of the run.

fields.name: run_failed
fields.doc: The run ended without finishing its answer. Last event of the run.

fields.name: memories_recalled
fields.doc: The memories a memory search returned.

fields.name: destinations_suggested
fields.doc: Places in the client the assistant offers the user to go to.

types.name: ai.v1.RunFailed
types.doc:
RunFailed is the last event of a run that ended without finishing its
 answer.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Why the run failed.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Short explanation to show the user.

fields.name: usage
fields.doc: Language-model usage of the run until it failed.

types.name: ai.v1.SendMessageRequest
types.doc:
SendMessageRequest sends the caller's message and starts a run that answers
 it.

cel.message: each destination id must be unique

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc: Conversation to continue. Omit to start a new conversation.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Message text, plain text or Markdown, 1 to 16000 characters.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes sending idempotent: the
 same key and request return the same run and conversation, also for a new
 conversation; another request with the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the run reads and acts on. It must be one
 the caller's account owns; any other value, also one that does not
 exist, is INVALID_ARGUMENT. Omit it to answer without account data: the
 run then has no account tools. It is part of the request the idempotency
 key covers.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: destinations
fields.doc:
The places in the client the run may suggest to the user, at most 100,
 each id at most once; their order does not matter. Omit them for a client
 that cannot take the user anywhere: the run then suggests nothing. They
 are part of the request the idempotency key covers.

types.name: ai.v1.SendMessageResponse
types.doc: SendMessageResponse identifies the started run.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc: The run that answers the message. Follow it with WatchRun.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc: The conversation of the message: the requested one, or the new one.

types.name: ai.v1.SetTelegramApprovalLimitsRequest
types.doc:
SetTelegramApprovalLimitsRequest replaces the caller's Telegram approval
 limits.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: The limits as they are from now on: an unset limit is turned off.

types.name: ai.v1.SetTelegramApprovalLimitsResponse
types.doc: SetTelegramApprovalLimitsResponse returns the limits as recorded.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: The limits now.

types.name: ai.v1.SkillLoaded
types.doc:
SkillLoaded reports that the assistant loaded a skill: instructions for one
 kind of task. A skill grants no extra tools or permissions.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Skill name, for example "market-analysis".

types.name: ai.v1.StopOrderPreview
types.doc:
StopOrderPreview is a stop-loss or take-profit: it places a market or limit
 order once the watched price reaches the trigger price.

fields.name: trigger_price
fields.doc: The price that fires it, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: The price it watches: LAST_PRICE or INDEX_PRICE.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Which way the watched price must move to reach trigger_price.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The limit price of the order it places, an exact decimal string in the
 quote asset. Omitted when it places a market order.

fields.name: time_in_force
fields.doc: GTC, IOC or FOK for a limit order. Unspecified for a market order.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: True when its limit order is refused instead of trading at once.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
For a market order: the most the price may move against it, in basis
 points. Omitted for a limit order, or when the market's default cap
 applies.

fields.name: funds_reserved
fields.doc:
True when the exchange reserves its funds when it creates it, before it
 fires. OrderPreview.reserved_amount states the amount when it is set.

types.name: ai.v1.SubagentFinished
types.doc: SubagentFinished reports the end of a delegated task.

fields.name: subagent_id
fields.doc: Identifier of the delegation, as in its SubagentStarted event.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Subagent name.

fields.name: ok
fields.doc: True when the subagent completed its task.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: Short summary of the subagent's result. Omitted when it has none.

types.name: ai.v1.SubagentStarted
types.doc:
SubagentStarted reports that the assistant delegated a task to a subagent,
 a helper with its own instructions, tools and budget.

fields.name: subagent_id
fields.doc: Identifier of the delegation, unique within the run.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Subagent name, for example "strategy-researcher".

types.name: ai.v1.SwapLegPreview
types.doc: SwapLegPreview is one spot market a swap's quote trades on.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL: the side of the swap's order on the market.

fields.name: average_price
fields.doc:
Estimated average fill price, in the quote asset per base asset, as a
 decimal string. Indicative: it comes from the quote's order-book depth.

fields.name: price_impact_bps
fields.doc:
Distance of average_price from the best price of the book, in basis
 points: the cost of the order's size against the depth.

fields.name: taker_fee_rate_percent
fields.doc:
The account's spot taker fee rate on the market, in percent (for example
 "0.1" for 0.1%), as a decimal string.

fields.name: fee
fields.doc: Estimated fee, an exact decimal string in fee_asset.

fields.name: fee_asset
fields.doc: Asset the fee is charged in: the asset the leg receives.

types.name: ai.v1.SwapPreview
types.doc:
SwapPreview is the swap an approval executes: spend amount of source_asset
 from the trading account's Trading balance and receive destination_asset
 there, through the spot order books at the account's taker fee. Nothing
 leaves the account. Only min_amount_out binds: what cannot trade at that
 rate, and any rest smaller than one order step, stays on the account.

fields.name: source_asset
fields.doc: Asset spent, for example "USDT".

fields.name: destination_asset
fields.doc: Asset received, for example "BTC".

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount spent, an exact decimal string in source_asset.

fields.name: expected_amount_out
fields.doc:
Estimated amount received after fees at the quote's order-book depth, an
 exact decimal string in destination_asset. Indicative.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
The least the swap receives after fees for the whole amount, an exact
 decimal string in destination_asset. Every traded part nets at least
 this rate.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
The accepted shortfall of min_amount_out from expected_amount_out, in
 basis points.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc: The markets the swap trades on, in order. A direct swap has one.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.doc: When the quote was priced.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
The quote's expiry, 30 seconds after quoted_at. Approving after it
 executes nothing: the swap is requested again for a new quote.

types.name: ai.v1.TelegramApprovalLimits
types.doc:
TelegramApprovalLimits are the caller's optional limits on what they may
 approve from Telegram, in US dollars of notional value. Each is off unless
 set. They apply to placing orders, swapping, modifying orders or triggers
 and resuming a trigger; cancelling, pausing a trigger and rejecting are
 never limited. Stablecoin amounts count one US dollar per unit; other
 amounts are valued at the current market price, and an approval that
 cannot be valued is refused while a limit is set.

fields.name: per_approval_usd
fields.doc:
Largest notional value one approval from Telegram may have, in US
 dollars: a decimal string with at most 2 decimal places, for example
 "5000" or "250.50". "0" allows none. Unset: no limit.

fields.name: daily_usd
fields.doc:
Largest total notional value of approvals from Telegram in any rolling
 24 hours, in US dollars, in the same format. Unset: no limit.

types.name: ai.v1.TextDelta
types.doc: TextDelta appends text to the assistant's answer.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Markdown text to append, in order, to the text received so far.

types.name: ai.v1.ToolFinished
types.doc:
ToolFinished reports the end of a tool call. Results to show arrive as View
 and MemoriesRecalled events.

fields.name: tool_call_id
fields.doc: Identifier of the call, as in its ToolStarted event.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Tool name.

fields.name: ok
fields.doc: True when the tool succeeded.

fields.name: error_message
fields.doc: Short explanation of the failure. Omitted when ok is true.

types.name: ai.v1.ToolStarted
types.doc: ToolStarted reports that the assistant started a tool call.

fields.name: tool_call_id
fields.doc: Identifier of the call, unique within the run.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Tool name, for example "get_candles".

fields.name: input
fields.doc: Arguments the tool was called with.

types.name: ai.v1.TrailingStopPreview
types.doc:
TrailingStopPreview is a trailing stop: it follows the watched price by a
 distance and fires when the price reverses by that distance. A sell
 tracks the highest price and sells at market; a buy tracks the lowest
 price and buys with an immediate-or-cancel limit order.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: A price distance, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: distance_bps
fields.doc: A distance in basis points of the price: 50 is 0.5%.

fields.name: activation_price
fields.doc:
Tracking starts once the price reaches it, an exact decimal string in
 the quote asset. Omitted when tracking starts at once.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: The price it watches: LAST_PRICE or INDEX_PRICE.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The most a buy pays, an exact decimal string in the quote asset. Set only
 for a buy.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
For a sell: the most the price may move against its market order, in
 basis points. Omitted when the market's default cap applies.

fields.name: funds_reserved
fields.doc:
True when the exchange reserves its funds when it creates it, before it
 fires. OrderPreview.reserved_amount states the amount when it is set.

types.name: ai.v1.TransfersTable
types.doc: TransfersTable shows the caller's settled transfers, one row per leg.

fields.name: transfers
fields.doc:
Transfer legs newest first, as ListTransfers returns them for the
 caller's trading account. ts_us has millisecond precision.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: True when more transfers matched than the table shows.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the transfers were read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.TriggerChangeAction
types.doc: TriggerChangeAction is what an approval does to a trigger.

values.name: MODIFY
values.doc:
Changes its trigger price, trailing distance, activation price or
 slippage cap.

values.name: PAUSE
values.doc: Pauses it: it keeps its settings and reserve but does not fire.

values.name: RESUME
values.doc: Resumes a paused trigger.

types.name: ai.v1.TriggerChangePreview
types.doc:
TriggerChangePreview is the exact change an approval makes to one
 stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop: its settings before and after.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Market symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: base_asset
fields.doc: Base asset, for example "BTC".

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset, for example "USDT".

fields.name: type
fields.doc: STOP_LOSS, TAKE_PROFIT or TRAILING_STOP.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Its quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset. Never changes.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: MODIFY, PAUSE or RESUME.

fields.name: before
fields.doc: The settings now.

fields.name: after
fields.doc: The settings once the change applies.

fields.name: reference_price
fields.doc:
The price it watches, to draw its trigger price against. Omitted for a
 pause, and when the market has no such price.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc:
Which way the watched price must move to reach the trigger price.
 Unspecified for a trailing stop.

fields.name: reserve_increase
fields.doc: What the change reserves in addition.

fields.name: reserve_release
fields.doc: What the change releases.

fields.name: fires_on_resume
fields.doc:
True for a resume when the watched price is already past the trigger
 price: the trigger fires as soon as it resumes.

types.name: ai.v1.TriggerDirection
types.doc:
TriggerDirection is which way the watched price must move to fire a
 trigger.

values.name: AT_OR_ABOVE
values.doc: Fires when the watched price rises to or above the trigger price.

values.name: AT_OR_BELOW
values.doc: Fires when the watched price falls to or below the trigger price.

types.name: ai.v1.TriggerSettings
types.doc:
TriggerSettings are the settings of a stop-loss, take-profit or trailing
 stop that a change can touch, with its status.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The trigger's status: PAUSED after a pause; ARMED after a resume.

fields.name: trigger_price
fields.doc:
A stop-loss's or take-profit's trigger price, an exact decimal string in
 the quote asset. Omitted for a trailing stop.

fields.name: trailing_distance_price
fields.doc: A price distance, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: trailing_distance_bps
fields.doc: A distance in basis points of the price: 50 is 0.5%.

fields.name: activation_price
fields.doc:
A trailing stop's activation price, an exact decimal string in the quote
 asset. Omitted when tracking starts at once.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: In basis points of the price: 50 is 0.5%.

fields.name: max_slippage_price
fields.doc: A price distance, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
The limit price of the order it places, or a buy trailing stop's most it
 pays, an exact decimal string in the quote asset. Never changes. Omitted
 when it places a market order.

types.name: ai.v1.TriggersTable
types.doc:
TriggersTable shows the caller's triggers: stop-losses, take-profits and
 trailing stops (standalone or attached to an order), TWAPs and ladders,
 with their configuration, status and progress.

fields.name: triggers
fields.doc:
Triggers in the order the assistant fetched them, usually newest first.
 Each carries the fields the assistant read: its configuration, status,
 terminal reason, progress and times. subaccount_id, fee_asset,
 self_trade_prevention_mode, updated_at, armed_at and version are not
 set.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: True when more triggers matched than the table shows.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Trading account (subaccount) the triggers were read from: the run's account, as
 SendMessageRequest.subaccount_id named it.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ai.v1.TwapPreview
types.doc:
TwapPreview is a TWAP: the quantity split into slices placed at a fixed
 interval. The first slice is placed at once, slice i (from 0) at
 i × slice_interval_ms after it.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc: Total duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: slice_interval_ms
fields.doc: Milliseconds between two slices.

fields.name: slice_count
fields.doc: Number of slices.

fields.name: slice_quantity
fields.doc:
The first slice's quantity, an exact decimal string in the base asset:
 quantity divided by slice_count, rounded down to the step size. Each
 later slice is the remaining quantity divided by the remaining slices,
 rounded down to the step size, so later slices may be slightly larger
 and the slices add up to quantity.

fields.name: limit_price
fields.doc:
Every slice's limit price, an exact decimal string in the quote asset.
 Omitted when slices are market orders.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
For market slices: the most the price may move against each slice, in
 basis points. Omitted for limit slices, or when the market's default cap
 applies.

fields.name: unfilled_slice_policy
fields.doc:
What happens to a limit slice that has not filled when the next slice is
 due: CANCEL_BEFORE_NEXT. Unspecified for market slices.

fields.name: first_slice_immediate
fields.doc:
True when the first slice is placed at once, when the TWAP is created;
 the later slices follow every slice_interval_ms.

types.name: ai.v1.UnfilledSlicePolicy
types.doc:
UnfilledSlicePolicy is what a TWAP does with a slice that has not filled
 when the next slice is due.

values.name: CANCEL_BEFORE_NEXT
values.doc: What is left of the slice is canceled before the next slice is placed.

types.name: ai.v1.Usage
types.doc: Usage is the language-model usage of one run, subagents included.

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.doc: Input tokens processed, cached input included.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.doc: Output tokens generated.

fields.name: cached_input_tokens
fields.doc: Input tokens served from the prompt cache; a subset of input_tokens.

types.name: ai.v1.View
types.doc:
View is structured content to render in the conversation, built from the
 result of a tool the assistant called, never from model-written text.

fields.name: orders_table
fields.doc: The caller's orders.

fields.name: balances_table
fields.doc: The caller's balances.

fields.name: price_chart
fields.doc: Candles of one spot market.

fields.name: markdown_table
fields.doc: A generic table.

fields.name: price_alert
fields.doc: One price alert of the caller, as the Price Alert API returns it.

fields.name: triggers_table
fields.doc: The caller's triggers.

fields.name: deposit_address
fields.doc: One deposit address of the caller.

fields.name: balance_history_chart
fields.doc: How the caller's balances changed over a window.

fields.name: equity_history_chart
fields.doc: The value of the caller's holdings over a window.

fields.name: transfers_table
fields.doc: The caller's settled transfers.

types.name: ai.v1.WatchRunRequest
types.doc: WatchRunRequest selects a run and where to resume its events.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc: Run to watch.

fields.name: after_seq
fields.doc:
Return events with seq greater than this value. 0 replays the run from
 its first event; to resume, pass the seq of the last event received.

types.name: ai.v1.WatchRunResponse
types.doc: WatchRunResponse carries one run event.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The event.
